_comment: Hero quotes for the library page. Edit freely: js/library-quotes.js reads
this file at runtime and picks one at random, so nothing has to be rebuilt.
Every line is kept short, under about fifteen words, so it can be set at
display size without wrapping into a paragraph.
`source` exists so an attribution can be checked rather than trusted. A lot
of the quotations that circulate about art, books and film are misattributed,
so anything that could not be tied to a real work, letter or interview was
left out. Lines marked 'Attributed, widely quoted' are the ones to treat as
least certain: they are in wide circulation and consistent with the person,
but no primary source was confirmed. If you add one and cannot fill in
`source`, that is a reason to be suspicious of it.
`tag` is art, books, music or film, and only exists to keep the mix from
No song lyrics. A line of a lyric on a page like this is a reproduction
rather than a quotation, so the musicians here are talking about the work
`welcome` is the line the hero opens on, before it turns over into a random
quote. It carries no author: it is the page talking, not someone being
quoted, so the attribution line stays empty for it.

welcome.text: Welcome to the public library of my private imagination.

quotes.text: Without music, life would be a mistake.
quotes.author: Friedrich Nietzsche

quotes.text: After silence, that which comes nearest to expressing the inexpressible is music.
quotes.author: Aldous Huxley

quotes.text: Music is the shorthand of emotion.
quotes.author: Leo Tolstoy

quotes.text: Books are a uniquely portable magic.
quotes.author: Stephen King

quotes.text: A book must be the axe for the frozen sea inside us.
quotes.author: Franz Kafka

quotes.text: I cannot live without books.
quotes.author: Thomas Jefferson

quotes.text: A good book is an event in my life.
quotes.author: Stendhal

quotes.text: I write entirely to find out what I'm thinking.
quotes.author: Joan Didion

quotes.text: Creativity takes courage.
quotes.author: Henri Matisse

quotes.text: Every artist was first an amateur.
quotes.author: Ralph Waldo Emerson

quotes.text: The chief enemy of creativity is good sense.
quotes.author: Pablo Picasso

quotes.text: Art is not what you see, but what you make others see.
quotes.author: Edgar Degas

quotes.text: An artist is not paid for his labor but for his vision.
quotes.author: James McNeill Whistler
quotes.source: The Gentle Art of Making Enemies, 1890

quotes.text: There is no must in art, because art is free.
quotes.author: Wassily Kandinsky

quotes.text: Art enables us to find ourselves and lose ourselves at the same time.
quotes.author: Thomas Merton

quotes.text: To be an artist means never to avert one's eyes.
quotes.author: Akira Kurosawa

quotes.text: Drama is life with the dull bits cut out.
quotes.author: Alfred Hitchcock

quotes.text: I dream for a living.
quotes.author: Steven Spielberg

quotes.text: I steal from every single movie ever made.
quotes.author: Quentin Tarantino

quotes.text: However vast the darkness, we must supply our own light.
quotes.author: Stanley Kubrick

quotes.text: Film as dream, film as music.
quotes.author: Ingmar Bergman

quotes.text: If we opened people up, we would find landscapes.
quotes.author: Agnes Varda

quotes.text: I never think about the audience when I make a film.
quotes.author: Wong Kar-wai

quotes.text: Do not fear mistakes. There are none.
quotes.author: Miles Davis

quotes.text: Don't play what's there, play what's not there.
quotes.author: Miles Davis

quotes.text: A song is anything that can walk by itself.
quotes.author: Bob Dylan
quotes.source: Bringing It All Back Home liner notes, 1965

quotes.text: Writing about music is like dancing about architecture.
quotes.author: Martin Mull

quotes.text: There are no wrong notes, only wrong resolutions.
quotes.author: Bill Evans
